nodes.name: Monday Webhook
nodes.notes: Public endpoint Monday POSTs to on every event. After import, take the production URL and subscribe Monday's create_webhook to it.

nodes.name: Echo Challenge
nodes.notes: Monday's one-time subscription handshake: it sends a {challenge:'<token>'} POST and expects the same token echoed back.

nodes.name: Ack 200
nodes.notes: Acknowledge Monday immediately, then keep processing async.

nodes.name: Is Approval=Approved?
nodes.notes: Only act on changes to the Approval status column when the new value is 'Approved'. columnId color_mm45eqw3 is the Approval column on board 18416933791.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query($i:[ID!]){ items(ids:$i){ id name updates(limit:1){ body created_at } } }', variables: { i: [String($('Monday Webhook').item.json.body.event.pulseId)] } }) }}

nodes.name: Fetch card update
nodes.notes: Pulls the most recent update body from the approved Monday card — that's where monday-card.sh posts the decision text + the [DECISION JSON] block.

nodes.name: Holding draft exists?
nodes.notes: Some escalations have a holding draft (e.g. ACH neutral acknowledgment); others have draft=null. Skip Gmail draft creation if null.

nodes.name: Create approved Gmail draft
nodes.notes: Same Gmail credential as the main workflow (np9bdfleWVRNhyXu). Creates the holding draft — human still has to click Send.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation($b:ID!,$i:ID!,$c:String!,$v:String!){ change_simple_column_value(board_id:$b,item_id:$i,column_id:$c,value:$v){ id } }', variables: { b: '18416933791', i: String($('Parse decision JSON').item.json.pulseId), c: 'color_mm45eqw3', v: 'Draft Ready' } }) }}

nodes.name: Flip Approval → Draft Ready
nodes.notes: Update the card's Approval column to 'Draft Ready' so it doesn't re-fire on accidental re-clicks, and so the CS Lead sees the card moved forward.
